2e340351-7e43-449b-8de2-a590a34882b6.excerpt: Wan dip pɔsnal tinkin bɔt intɛgriti, aw mɔtalman de du tu fes, ɛn di strɔgul fɔ tinap pan prinsipul na wɔl we nɔ kia. I de luk di pen we de kam we wetin pɔsin biliv ɛn di kɔntradikshɔn dɛn na sosayti jam, ɛn na di ɛnd i de se klia se nɔto di at tɛm dɛn na layf de sho udat pɔsin rili bi, na wetin i dɔn disayd wit in yay opin se i nɔ go ɛva bi.
2e340351-7e43-449b-8de2-a590a34882b6.full_text:
Riality Ɛt Mi?

Frɔm Alpha Amadu Jalloh

A dɔn liv lɔng te a no se layf kin tɔn agens man we i nɔ wɔn am, we nɔ gɛt rizin, ɛn we i nɔ kia atɔl bɔt wetin i dɔn sakrifays fɔ kɔntinyu fɔ tinap. A dɔn si pipul dɛn de rayt di trut bak fɔ mek i fit wetin dɛn want, a dɔn si aw dɛn de tek loyalti lɛk fulishnɛs, ɛn a dɔn si aw izi i izi fɔ pɔsin in dignity fɔ tɔn sɔntin we ɔda pɔsin jɔs de yuz fɔ in yon kɔmfɔt. Wetin de trɔbul mi nɔto se layf dɔn at. Na di tin we de wɔri mi we a dɔn kam fɔ ɔndastand se sɔntɛm, di big big pɔnishmɛnt fɔ bi pɔsin we tru na fɔ sɔvayv midul pipul dɛn we dɔn masta di at fɔ mek lɛk.

A nɔ ɛva aks fɔ pafɛkt wɔl. Na jɔs dis a dɔn aks: wetin mek gud biayvyɔ fɔ strɔgul so bad bifo dɛn rɛkɔgnayz am, we lay lay biznɛs kin ɛnjɔy fɔ mek dɛn aksept am wit kɔmfɔt? Aw man go kɔntinyu fɔ biliv na mɔtalman we di sem pipul dɛn we de tɔk bɔt sɔri at kin nɔ kia atɔl bɔt di sɔfa we dɛn de kɔz? Na de mi agyumɛnt wit riality bigin.

A dɔn si inof fɔ ɔndastand se di wɔl nɔ ɔltɛm de pɔnish bad ɔ pe pɔsin we du rayt. Sɔntɛm, dɛn de sɛlibret lay lay pipul we dɛn de kwɛstyɔn di wan dɛn we de tɔk tru. Sɔntɛm, di wan dɛn we de pwɛl ɔda pipul dɛn nem de slip fayn we di pipul dɛn we dɛn wund de wach nɛt, nɔ slip, de tray fɔ gɛt dɛn dignity bak. A dɔn rich di ples we a fɔ aks misɛf if riality de agens mi, ɔ if na jɔs se a bin ɛkspɛkt tu mɔch mɔtalman biayvyɔ frɔm mɔtalman.

Wetin de disturb mi nɔto jɔs di disapɔyntmɛnt dɛn we a dɔn mit, bɔt aw izi i izi fɔ pipul lɛf dɛn prinsipul wans dɛn yon intrɛst de na denja. A dɔn lan se sɔm pipul dɛn lɛk ɔnɛsti jɔs we di trut nɔ go ɛkspos dɛn. Dɛn de prez loyalti te loyalti aks fɔ sakrifays. Dɛn de tɔk wit pashɔn bɔt jɔstis te jɔstis aks dɛn fɔ fes pɔsin we dɛn lɛk ɔ pɔsin we dɛn de it frɔm. Dis kayn kɔntradikshɔn dɔn fos mi fɔ tink bak bɔt wetin i min fɔ bi mɔtalman, ɛn if gud biayvyɔ dɔn tɔn sɔntin we pipul de advataiz pas fɔ du am.

A nɔ de se a pafɛkt. A dɔn mek mistek, a dɔn jɔj tin dɛn rɔng, a dɔn trɔst usay a bin fɔ kia, ɛn sɔntɛm a dɔn alaw fil fɔ ambɔg sɛns. Bɔt a nɔ gri fɔ aksept se bikɔs pɔsin nɔ pafɛkt, dat wan nɔmɔ mek i nɔ fit fɔ gɛt rɛspɛkt, ɔndastandin, ɔ fɛyanɛs. Sɔntin de we de wɔri pɔsin bad bad bɔt sosayti we de aks di wan dɛn we nɔ gɛt pawa fɔ ansa fɔ wetin dɛn du, we i de mek ɛkskyuz fɔ di wan dɛn we gɛt pawa.

A dɔn fɛn se wan pan di tin dɛn we de mek pɔsin fil lonli pas ɔl na layf na we pipul dɛn we dɔn ɔlrɛdi disayd wetin dɛn want fɔ biliv bɔt yu nɔ ɔndastand yu. Yu kin ɛksplen yusɛf bak ɛn bak, sho yu intɛnshɔn wit ɔnɛsti, ɛn stil fɛn se sɔm maynd nɔ de luk fɔ trut. Na fɔ kɔnfam wetin dɛn dɔn ɔlrɛdi jɔj na dɛn at dɛn de luk fɔ. Da kayn tɛm de, fɔ kip kwayɛt kin bi ples fɔ ayd ɛn pɔnishmɛnt di sem tɛm, bikɔs fɔ tɔk nɔ de chenj natin, we fɔ kip kwayɛt de alaw lay fɔ gro.

Bɔt a nɔ go mek lɛk se ɛvri at tɛm dɔn mek a strɔng. Sɔm tin dɛn we a dɔn pas tru dɔn taya mi. Sɔm disapɔyntmɛnt dɔn chenj aw a de trɔst. Sɔm mitin dɔn mek a de aks if tru tru sɔri at dɔn de tɔn rɛr tin we mɔtalman de ajiv, pas wan ɔdinari dyuti fɔ gud biayvyɔ. A nɔ de shem fɔ gri wit dɛn tin ya, bikɔs fɔ gri se sɔntin dɔn wund mi nɔ min se a dɔn sɔrɛnda to am.

A de fred mɔ fɔ tɔn pɔsin we in at dɔn dai pas fɔ gri se dɛn dɔn wund mi. Bikɔs wetin man go tɔn if i sɔvayv wikɛdnɛs jɔs fɔ du di sem wikɛdnɛs? Us win de fɔ rɔnawe frɔm injɔstis if wetin i pas tru tɔn am to ɔda tul fɔ ɔprɛshɔn? Dɛn kwɛstyɔn ya impɔtant to mi bikɔs a nɔ want mek bita at tɔn udat a bi, no mata aw mɔch rizin layf dɔn gi mi fɔ ol am tayt.

Sɔntɛm mi big big strɔgul na fɔ aksept se a nɔ go ebul fos di wɔl fɔ waka di we mi kɔnshɛns se. A nɔ go ebul aks se ɛvribɔdi rɛkɔgnayz se a sinsia, ɛn a nɔ go ebul fos tin dɛn fɔ rɛspɛkt wetin a de ɛkspɛkt. Bɔt a go ebul disayd wetin di tin dɛn we a dɔn pas tru go mek a tɔn. A go ebul tinap pan prinsipul we a nɔ tɔn fulish, gɛt sɔri at we a nɔ sɔrɛnda mi dignity, ɛn gɛt kɔrej we a nɔ de mek lɛk se fred nɔ de.

So, we a aks, "Riality Ɛt Mi?" a nɔ jɔs de sho se a vɛks. A de fes di distans we de pen bitwin di wɔl lɛk aw i fɔ bi ɛn di wɔl lɛk aw i rili bi.

A nɔ nid mek riality fevo mi. A nid di kɔrej fɔ fes am we a nɔ sɛl misɛf. Ɛn if mi layf fɔ kɔntinyu fɔ bi agyumɛnt we nɔ gɛt ɛnd bitwin sɔfa ɛn wetin a biliv strɔng, a dɔn mek ɔp mi maynd fɔ mek shɔ se nɔbɔdi nɔ go ɛva shɛt di mɔt fɔ wetin a biliv.

Bikɔs a nɔto jɔs wetin layf dɔn du mi.

A bi bak wetin a dɔn disayd wit mi yay opin se a nɔ go ɛva tɔn.
